content.name: Detect Magic
entries: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic in this way, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears magic, and you learn its {@book school of magic|SRD51|10|The Schools of Magic}, if any.
The spell can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

content.name: Detect Magic
entries: For the duration, you sense the presence of magical effects within 30 feet of yourself. If you sense such effects, you can take the {@action Magic|SRD52} action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object in the area that bears the magic, and if an effect was created by a spell, you learn the spell's {@book school of magic|SRD52|7|Schools of Magic}.
The spell is blocked by 1 foot of stone, dirt, or wood; 1 inch of metal; or a thin sheet of lead.
